SELECT 
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN sa.status = 'empty' THEN CAST(sa.audit_ts AS DATE) END) as empty_days,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CAST(sa.audit_ts AS DATE)) as total_days
FROM store.shelf_audits sa
JOIN store.products p ON sa.sku = p.sku
WHERE p.name = 'Whole wheat atta 5 kg'
  AND sa.audit_ts >= '2026-06-01' 
  AND sa.audit_ts <= '2026-06-30 23:59:59';

SELECT 
    SUM(ds.units_sold * (1 - (CAST(empty_days AS FLOAT) / NULLIF(total_days, 0)))) as estimated_lost_sales
FROM (
    SELECT 
        SUM(units_sold) as units_sold 
    FROM store.daily_sales ds 
    JOIN store.products p ON ds.sku = p.sku 
    WHERE p.name = 'Whole wheat atta 5 kg' 
      AND ds.date >= '2026-06-01' 
      AND ds.date <= '2026-06-30'
) ds,
